name: Hidden Bog

source.title: Pathfinder Bounty #6: The Road from Otari

disable: 2 DC 15 Crafting check or 2 DC 18 Thievery check to create a makeshift plank across the hidden bog; creatures can then traverse the hazard's area without stepping into the mud.
reset: Creatures can still step into the mud after the trap is revealed, but the area containing the mud is obvious.

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creatures enters the 10-foot-square area of the hidden bog

---

Effect The creatures squelches into two feet of sticky mud, ending its move action. The mud imposes a -10 foot penalty to the creature's Speed until it is wiped off (requiring 3).

text: This section of grass-strewn ground hides a pool of sticky mud 10 feet across.
